_doc: hetz core profile, pre-checked in /hetz:setup global and applied to ~/.claude/settings.json by scripts/hetz_settings.py. Merge: dicts merge, arrays union, existing differing values (env included) are kept unless forced. {placeholders} are filled at apply time. Verified against Claude Code 2.1.272.

cap.label: Compact at 200k
cap.why: 1M-window models otherwise compact at ~967k; 63% of the measured bill came from requests over 600k context.

env.label: Env knobs
env.why: General-purpose subagents on Sonnet, no prompt-suggestion request per turn, idle /clear nudge tuned to the cache TTL.

glob-deny.label: Glob respects .gitignore + min/map deny
glob-deny.why: Glob ignores .gitignore by default; //-anchored deny blocks minified bundles and source maps in every project (no lockfiles: Read deny also blocks Edit).
glob-deny.selftest: ask Claude to Read any *.min.js file -> expect a permission denial

concise.label: Concise output style
concise.why: Built-in first-party style: result first, no preamble or recap. Kept off if you already chose a style.

statusline.label: hetz statusline
statusline.why: Zero-token meter: model, ctx tokens vs compact window, cache warm/cold, $.
statusline.selftest: the status bar shows `model │ ctx …/200k │ cache … │ $…`
